summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs detects platform and libc (glibc vs musl), downloads a matching Bun binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js on `npm install`. math_init.js is a single-line ~727KB Bun bundle whose contents are obfuscated with a rotated string-constant array (WV8StW rotator over the n7gIxM array), a char-transform string decoder, hex-mangled identifiers, and repeated `with(...)` blocks that break strict-mode parsers and standard JavaScript deobfuscators. The payload runs under a freshly fetched alternate runtime rather than the installer's Node, bypassing Node-based tracing and scanners, and its purpose is not discoverable from the source. This behavior has no relationship to the package's declared purpose as a React hooks library for a customer portal.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
